#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
: "${CUDA_HOME:=/usr/local/cuda}"
export PATH="$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$CUDA_HOME/lib:$CUDA_HOME/lib64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
if [[ ! -x registry-build/bin/llama-server ]]; then
    cmake -S . -B registry-build -G Ninja \
        -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=86 \
        -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${CC:-gcc}" -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="${CXX:-g++}" \
        -DCMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER="$CUDA_HOME/bin/nvcc" \
        -DCMAKE_CUDA_HOST_COMPILER="${CXX:-g++}" \
        -DGGML_CUDA=ON -DLLAMA_CURL=OFF -DLLAMA_BUILD_MTMD=OFF
    cmake --build registry-build --target llama-server -j "${BUILD_JOBS:-6}"
fi
exec ./registry-build/bin/llama-server -m weights/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-ultra-uncensored-heretic-Q3_K_M.gguf --alias gemma4-26b-ultra-heretic-q3_k_m --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18392 -c 131072 -np 1 -ub 1024 -b 1024 -fa on -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 --jinja --cors-origins localhost
